description: Create #authority cloud prompt-cache expiry and idle compaction policy module with 0 surviving mutants and wire it into agyworker.coax (#14031, from chat ba6d40e0).

steps.send: Implement Layer-2 cloud prompt-cache expiry and idle compaction policy (#14031): 1) Create an `#authority` Coax module `coax/lib/agent/engine/cache-policy.coax` modeling a default 5-minute (`300000` ms) and custom TTL prompt-cache expiry (`CP_CACHE_WARM`, `CP_CACHE_EXPIRED`, `CP_CACHE_EXPIRED_COMPACT`) that classifies whether a cloud session's prompt cache is still warm, expired, or expired and eligible for `/compact` (when `context_tokens >= 16000` and `can_compact` is true), with `#test` checks that kill 100% of mutants under `coax/bin/coax mutate coax/lib/agent/engine/cache-policy.coax --root-only`. 2) Load `cache-policy.coax` into `coder/tui/agyworker.coax` and add `#test` coverage verifying warm/expired/compact transitions. Verify with `coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/agent/engine/cache-policy.coax --library && coax/bin/coax mutate coax/lib/agent/engine/cache-policy.coax --root-only && coax/bin/coax test coder/tui/agyworker.coax --library`.

graders.run: test -f coax/lib/agent/engine/cache-policy.coax && grep -q '^#authority;' coax/lib/agent/engine/cache-policy.coax && grep -q 'cache-policy.coax' coder/tui/agyworker.coax && coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/agent/engine/cache-policy.coax --library && coax/bin/coax mutate coax/lib/agent/engine/cache-policy.coax --root-only && coax/bin/coax test coder/tui/agyworker.coax --library
